note: What tools/restructure took out of which browser file, in order. Written by `browser extract`, `browser split-css`, `browser inline`, `browser module`, `browser inner` and `browser state`, read by `browser verify` and by server/test/browser-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

moves.about: The panels of the lighting page: the master card, the devices, the effects with their animation and palette, and the reactions to events.
